notes.title: Patch #1
notes.notes:
What have we done?

Well....

Multiple new destructible objects
Increased enemy alerts, along with some other audio balancing
A more involved and clearer tutorial level
We heard some of you - slightly more difficult enemies and bosses!
Fixed broken textures and general bug fixes that prevents the player from “falling off the map”
Even more secrets
Improved lighting
Replaced/Improved hazard textures/tiles
Removed most enemy drops


This should refine the experience and fix a lot of your issues - we hope you have fun! Please report any bugs you find in the comments below - we can't fix everything sadly, but we will try!

notes.title: A QUICK UPDATE
notes.notes:
Today is your last chance to get the game at its 10% off launch discount! We will undoubtedly be taking part in future Steam sales, but if you want your cheap game cheaper this is your moment! As Arnold Schwarzenegger would say - [b]DO IT NAOW[/b]

But also we have some news! Some of you have encountered some bugs, and we're aiming to fix those with a patch later this week. Not everything you've reported can be fixed at this time sadly, but we will provide patch notes so you can check through and track your issue!

Lastly, we really want to thank you for such a fantastic launch. 
We're currently sitting at 97% positive and almost 40 reviews! What a week it has been! Keep your eyes peeled for more from both Twisted Sickle and DOSMan Games in the future, we really want to keep making cool projects for you guys!

See you on the Steam forums!
